verdicts.reason: A: the headline is shrunk to one weak line, about the same size as the book title, and it floats on its own. There are big, uneven gaps above and below it (~100px from the book, ~80px to the subcopy) and only ~40px from the subcopy to the small CTA, so the text block falls apart and the headline doesn't stand out. B keeps a larger two-line headline grouped tightly with the subcopy and a bigger CTA, so the hierarchy holds. But it repeats the orphaned 'spring' break, leaves a large gap between the book and the headline, and, like A, is just the tall layout centred in a square, with wide empty side margins and a small book.
